Seamless 360 degree cylindrical panorama strip, a skybox backdrop for a stylised video game with the stylised realism of a modern Nintendo golf game: believable light and atmosphere, bold saturated colour, slightly painterly. A perfectly straight level horizon line runs across the whole image at one fifth of the height from the bottom edge. Below the horizon only rolling golden sand dunes. Above it a desert sunset: the sky runs from blazing orange at the horizon through magenta to deep blue above, a few thin gilded clouds, a large low sun in the left third sinking into the haze just above the dunes. All the way round the horizon lie endless dunes in soft layers. In the centre of the image, far off and tiny in the haze, stands an invented ancient desert city of flat-roofed mud-brick towers, domes and obelisks, no taller than one tenth of the image height. No foreground objects, no people, no animals, no text, no logos, no real landmarks, no lens flare streaks, no vignette, no frame. The left edge and the right edge match exactly so the strip wraps around seamlessly.
